title: The showroom is a second runway
technology: SPHERE, The New Black, buyer access
governingQuestion: How does emerging design move from official visibility toward an order?
status: evidence-backed production draft; recording, interviews and owner-final approval remain open

longform.headline: The showroom is a second runway
longform.opening: The runway produces attention. SPHERE tries to route some of it toward a market.

sections.heading: Then
sections.copy: FHCM says it has operated SPHERE since January 2020 to support selected emerging brands.

sections.heading: Now
sections.copy: For the 2026 womenswear session, FHCM identifies Palais de Tokyo, an invitation-only digital version and The New Black as its technology provider.

sections.heading: Next—and the limit
sections.copy: The public showroom page does not reveal private buyer accounts, prices, order volumes, sell-through or participating brands’ downstream systems.

longform.closing: Paris Fashion Week is not one technology. It is a chain of permissions that turns recognition into circulation and circulation into memory.
